content.key_idea: The complex dependency graph of a real microservice application (Left) motivates Cilantro's ability to optimize an end-to-end objective like P99 latency directly, and the accompanying plots (Center, Right) show Cilantro converging to lower, more stable P99 latency than Resource-Fair, ε-greedy, and EvoAlg baselines as it allocates a shared 160-CPU cluster among the application's microservices.
content.reading_order: Left: queries enter the Frontend and fan out through business-logic microservices to their caches/databases, illustrating a complex dependency graph. Center: raw P99 latency over time for four methods. Right: the same methods' time-averaged P99 latency, showing Cilantro converging lowest.

summary: Figure 12 combines a microservices architecture diagram with an evaluation comparison. The Left panel shows the DeathStarBench Hotel Reservation application: user queries enter a Frontend and fan out to business-logic microservices (Geo, Profile, Search, Reserve, Rate, User, Recommend, color-coded blue) running on a Consul service mesh with Jaeger tracing (purple), backed by MongoDB databases (yellow) and memcached caches (red); Search additionally composes results from Geo, Rate, and Profile. The Center and Right panels use this application's full 160-CPU cluster to compare Cilantro against Resource-Fair, ε-greedy, and EvoAlg allocation policies: Center plots raw P99 latency over time (all methods explore early on), and Right plots the time-averaged P99 latency, where Cilantro converges to the lowest, most stable latency. The figure argues that Cilantro's ability to optimize an end-to-end objective directly handles this kind of complex microservice dependency graph better than the baselines.
summary_zh: 图12左侧为酒店预订微服务架构（业务逻辑、缓存、数据库、网络服务按颜色区分，Search综合Geo/Rate/Profile结果）；中右两图在160核集群上比较Cilantro与三种基线方法的P99时延，Cilantro最优。
notes: layout-proposal: architecture-plus-results triptych — a microservices dependency diagram (Left) placed beside two time-series comparison plots (Center, Right) for the same experiment; no single named template covers a diagram-plus-charts figure like this. The measured index reports panels=1 (the three regions are one combined image); some Left-panel dependency edges (e.g., Search's links to Geo/Rate/Profile) are read from the figure rather than spelled out in the available prose.
